author: Gregory
html: The example for manually caching using Optional.orElse(/* Get thing */) to operate on the cache miss. Unfortunately, the orElse() method is evaluated every time the expression is called. If you change it to Optional.ofNullable(cache.get(key, Thing.class)).orElseGet(() -> /* Get thing */);, then the “Get thing” code will only be evaluated when actually needed.
